Victorian Art Fair returns to Irons Park

By Mark Constance
August 3, 2026
101
Facebook
X
Email
    Listen to audio version of this article
    Sponsored by
    0:00 / 1:59
    Instaread

    Editor’s Note: Interested in free Thursday updates from Northeast Michigan? Sign up for the UP NORTH VOICE MAIL

    WEST BRANCH — Art, handmade crafts and Victorian charm will fill Irons Park when the annual Victorian Art Fair returns to West Branch on Saturday, Aug. 8, and Sunday, Aug. 9.

    The fair will be open from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. Saturday and 10 a.m. to 4 p.m. Sunday at Irons Park, 335 Shrigley St. Admission is free.

    Sponsored by the West Branch Creative Arts Association, the juried fair brings artists and craftspeople together to display and sell original handmade work. Exhibitors must show work they created rather than commercially manufactured, imported or mass-produced items.

    Visitors can browse artwork and handcrafted goods while enjoying food, beverages, live performances, contests and children’s activities. Food concessions are operated by local nonprofit organizations.

    The Victorian Art Fair has been part of West Branch for nearly five decades. The West Branch Creative Arts Association was organized in 1974 to encourage art and creativity among adults and young people. The association established the Victorian Outdoor Fair at Irons Park in 1979.

    The event also reflects West Branch’s longtime effort to preserve its Victorian identity. Association leaders were involved in “Operation Pride,” a community effort to give downtown a stronger Victorian look and celebrate the city’s history.

    A free shuttle will operate between Irons Park, Plaza East, the former Kmart/McLaren parking area, downtown West Branch and the Fourth Street Gift Shop & Gallery. Shuttle service will run from 9 a.m.-5 p.m. Saturday and noon-4 p.m. Sunday. An ATM will also be available at the fair.

    The West Branch Creative Arts Association also operates the Fourth Street Artists Gallery at 124 N. Fourth St. in downtown West Branch.

    For more information about the Victorian Art Fair, visit victorianartfair.com, email victorianartfair@gmail.com or call Marcia Young at 989-345-1333.
